final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.TAT - l.TAT2) AS avg_tat_diff FROM Laboratory AS l WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE "U-PRO" = '-') AND l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE RA = '-') GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT AVG(avg_pt) AS average_of_group_average_pt, AVG(avg_tat_diff) AS average_of_group_average_tat_difference FROM step1
